paper_metadata.title: NVLM: Open Frontier-Class Multimodal LLMs
paper_metadata.abstract: We introduce NVLM 1.0, a family of frontier-class multimodal large language models (LLMs) that achieve state-of-the-art results on vision-language tasks, rivaling the leading proprietary models (e.g., GPT-4o) and open-access models (e.g., Llama 3-V 405B and InternVL 2). Remarkably, NVLM 1.0 shows improved text-only performance over its LLM backbone after multimodal training. In terms of model design, we perform a comprehensive comparison between decoder-only multimodal LLMs (e.g., LLaVA) and cross-attention-based models (e.g., Flamingo). Based on the strengths and weaknesses of both approaches, we propose a novel architecture that enhances both training efficiency and multimodal reasoning capabilities. Furthermore, we introduce a 1-D tile-tagging design for tile-based dynamic high-resolution images, which significantly boosts performance on multimodal reasoning and OCR-related tasks. Regarding training data, we meticulously curate and provide detailed information on our multimodal pretraining and supervised fine-tuning datasets. Our findings indicate that dataset quality and task diversity are more important than scale, even during the pretraining phase, across all architectures. Notably, we develop production-grade multimodality for the NVLM-1.0 models, enabling them to excel in vision-language tasks while maintaining and even improving text-only performance compared to their LLM backbones. To achieve this, we craft and integrate a high-quality text-only dataset into multimodal training, alongside a substantial amount of multimodal math and reasoning data, leading to enhanced math and coding capabilities across modalities. To advance research in the field, we release the model weights at https://huggingface.co/nvidia/NVLM-D-72B and will open-source the training code for the community soon.

extraction_data.innovation: Decoder-only architecture: uses only self-attention layers for both text and image tokens, differing from cross-attention models by unrolling all image tokens in the LLM decoder; Dynamic High-Resolution (DHR) mechanism: dynamically divides images into 1-6 tiles based on aspect ratio, processes each with a frozen vision encoder, and applies pixel-shuffle downsampling to 256 tokens to reduce compute waste on varying resolutions.
extraction_data.training_pipeline: Pretraining on image-text pairs/interleaved data -> Supervised fine-tuning (SFT)

extraction_data.innovation: Novel decoder-only multimodal architecture that enhances training efficiency and reasoning; 1-D tile-tagging design for tile-based dynamic high-resolution images to boost OCR and reasoning; production-grade multimodality via integrating high-quality text-only datasets into multimodal training to maintain/improve text-only performance while excelling in vision-language tasks.
extraction_data.pretraining_corpus: COCO, CC3M, SBU, LAION-115M, VQAv2, VisualGenome, DVQA, Docmatix, OCR-VQA, COCO-Text, TextOCR, ReCTs, RRC-ArT, RRC-LSVT, RCTW, synthdog-en, pdfa-eng-wds, CLEVR-Math
extraction_data.finetuning_task: Multimodal instruction tuning, Supervised fine-tuning, Supervised fine-tuning (SFT)
extraction_data.extension: Connects the LLM and vision encoder via a two-layer MLP for modality alignment.
extraction_data.application: Visual Question Answering, Document Transcription, OCR, Grounded OCR, Referring Expression Grounding, Image Captioning, LaTeX Recognition

extraction_data.benchmark_result: OCRBench: 853; VQAv2: 85.4; MMMU: 59.7; AI2D: 85.2/94.2; TextVQA: 82.1; ChartQA: 86.0; DocVQA: 92.6; Real-WorldQA: 69.7; MMLU: +4.3; GSM8K: improved; MATH: improved; HumanEval: improved; MathVista: 65.2; AI2D: 94.2; RealWorldQA: 69.7; Text (MMLU, GSM8K, Math, HumanEval): 84.1; MMMU 54.1; MathVista 59.6; AI2D 80.7; ChartQA 79.2; DocVQA 80.9; TextVQA 78.6; OCRBench 744

extraction_data.innovation: Unified multimodal training format using `<image>` tags and ChatML template for SFT; supports diverse tasks like grounded OCR, document transcription, VQA, LaTeX recognition.

Simple, scalable architecture using a frozen OpenCLIP vision encoder and frozen LLaMA-2 LLM connected by a lightweight trainable MLP projector, enabling efficient scaling to frontier-class multimodal capabilities without full end-to-end fine-tuning of the backbone.
extraction_data.application: Visual question answering, document understanding, chart understanding, general multimodal tasks
